options.text: Do you have any quests for me?

steps.player: Do you have any quests for me?

steps.npc: I hear the Duke has a task for an adventurer. Otherwise, if you want to make yourself useful, there are always evil monsters to slay.

steps.player: Okay, I might just do that.
Can you give me any advice then?

steps.npc: I only advise the Duke. But if you want to make yourself useful, there are evil goblins to slay on the other side of the river.

after-the-lost-tribe.npc: ...And I would have gotten away with it too, if it wasn't for that pesky adventurer!
